Big sales do not mean you came out ahead.

Kevin Trudeau explains that many people misunderstand what a big milestone in business really means. A company can bring in huge sales, but if expenses are higher, the result is a loss.

He says the target is profit, not revenue. Sales are a number on a page, while profit is what stays with you.

Have you ever confused being busy with being profitable?
